0.content: Our mission at Life.Church is to lead people to become fully devoted followers of Christ. We hope this is where your skills, talents, and passions meet. God is telling a story here, and you can be part of it.

01.headingText: Make an impact with your work.

02.headingText: We believe a job is something you do, but a calling is who you are.

01.content: God calls people from a wide range of backgrounds to work at Life.Church, but He has us all here for one reason: to lead people to become fully devoted followers of Christ.

0.content: The Talent Community is your inside look at Life.Church and YouVersion. Get updates on open roles, learn more about our culture, and explore the latest developments from our teams.

0111.headingText: Be Part of the Talent Community

0.content: When you join the Life.Church team, our prayer is that your family will be closer, your leadership will be sharper, your finances will be stronger, your faith will be deeper, and your heart will be larger. And while the biggest perk to working at Life.Church is doing work that makes an eternal difference, you’ll find that’s not the only benefit we offer.

02.headingText: Life.Church is pleased to provide you with benefit offerings to help you take care of your health, wealth, and well-being now and into the future. We want each and every participant to stay healthy, feel secure and maintain a work/life balance by offering the highest quality benefits at the most affordable price possible to our team members.

0.content: Life.Church offers team members a 401(k) plan as a means for saving for retirement. Retirement contributions are both employee- and employer-paid at Life.Church. The Life.Church matching structure is based on years of service, generously matching up to 15% of team members’ annual salary at hire through 25% when you reach 10 years of service. Financial Advisors are also available to provide their expertise and knowledge at no cost to you.
0.title: Retirement Plan

00.title: Medical Coverage
00.content:
We proudly offer high-quality care to our team members and their families, ensuring we stay at the forefront of cutting-edge benefits.

Life.Church offers full-time staff a traditional Medical PPO plan. For a low monthly cost, our staff has access to this low deductible health plan that offers rich benefits and access to primary or specialty providers across a robust network.

01.title: Direct Primary Care
01.content: Direct Primary Care (DPC) offers world-class primary medical care that maximize the healthcare model in ways you wouldn’t experience through traditional care. Available to all team members and covered family members who are enrolled in the health plan, DPC’s membership is covered 100% by Life.Church and no cost to you.

03.title: Dental Coverage
03.content: We offer dental insurance to help pay for your dental care. In addition, our plan offers an Orthodontia option for optimal support to protect your smile.

04.content: VSP administers our vision coverage and offers a network of nationwide providers.
04.title: Vision Coverage

05.title: Wellness
05.content: We care about your wellbeing, which is why we offer a robust wellness platform to our team members and their spouses through Sonic Boom. This platform encompasses a social network of support at all of our locations and makes your wellness goals more achievable with daily challenges, healthy tips, and a generous rewards program.

06.content: We care about your whole family—it’s why we offer childcare benefits for all staff families. For team members in the Oklahoma City area, onsite childcare at our Central offices is available for children six weeks old through pre-K. When maximum enrollment is reached, interested staff members can be added to our waitlist. Availability is based on age and class size. For team members unable to use onsite childcare at our Central Offices, Life.Church sponsors a Dependent Care Allowance to help with daycare expenses.
06.title: Childcare

07.title: FSA and DCA
07.content: Paying for healthcare and daycare expenses can be stressful, which is why Life.Church offers a Flexible Spending Account and Dependent Care Account. The Flexible Spending Account allows our team members to set aside pre-tax contributions from their check to pay for eligible healthcare expenses. The account is prefunded in the beginning of the year or their benefits effective date. The Dependent Care Account allows our team members to set aside pre-tax contributions in an account to pay for eligible daycare expenses.

08.content:
We believe parenthood is a critical mission and are committed to supporting our team members as they welcome new additions to their families. That’s why we proudly offer paid leave for the birth of a child to our FMLA-eligible expectant mothers and fathers.

This time off runs concurrently with the Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) and includes paid leave for eligible parents looking to adopt. Our generous policy allows our team members to focus on bonding with their new children without worrying about job security or financial stability.
08.title: Parental Pay

09.title: Adoption Leave
09.content: At Life.Church we know that adoption is an important mission that some are called to. Life.Church supports this mission by compensating team members while they bond at home with their new addition. Adoptive parents receive six weeks of paid leave.

010.content: You can never predict when an untimely death occurs, but proper planning can reduce the financial burden on your loved ones. Life.Church offers life insurance and accidental death and dismemberment coverage for our team members.
010.title: Life Insurance and Accident Coverage

011.title: Short and Long Term Disability Coverage
011.content: If you were to become disabled and unable to work, Short-Term Disability would allow for you to receive 100% of your salary for up to 13 weeks covered at no cost to you by Life.Church. If this disability made it unable for you to return to work past 13 weeks, Long-Term Disability would allow for you to receive 60% of your salary until Social Security Normal Retirement Age also provided at no cost to you by Life.Church.

00.content: There’s a time to work and there’s a time to play, and we value both with our Life.Church family. We learn, have fun, and laugh together on a regular basis!

0.content: Working hard for something you believe in is incredibly rewarding, which is why we have a generous vacation policy. At Life.Church, you don’t have to earn your time off in order to relax and recharge.
0.title: Vacation Time

00.content: You’ll get the opportunities and financial support to help you grow spiritually, personally, and professionally. From training and books to seminars and workshops, there are development opportunities for everyone!
00.title: Development Dollars

01.content: When you work at Life.Church, you’ll find that everyone has their style—from casual to professional. What you wear is less important than who you are, so wear whatever makes you ready to get the job done.
01.title: Casual Dress-Code

0.headingText: Enjoy these benefits and more when you bring your skills to Life.

internal.title: Our Culture and Values | Life.Church Careers

01.headingText: It’s been our mission since we started in 1996, and it’s guided us every day since. In fact, leading people isn’t just an expectation, it’s a necessity. It’s a cornerstone of our culture. It’s why we’re always seeking leaders—like you—to bring their skills to Life.

0.headingText: To lead people to become fully devoted followers of Christ.

01.content:
To live out the mission of our church, we actively build our culture through aligning values.

Every person on our team knows how powerful it is to serve God alongside people with a passion to build a healthy culture. It's the glue that keeps our team on track over time.

02.headingText: “There’s so much passion and intentionality to live and carry out our mission on a daily basis. We are given the freedom to dream and lead ourselves, others, and our ministries.”

00.content:
While we unite around our mission, we know unity doesn't mean uniformity. Our calling is too great and our mission is too important not to be intentional about strengthening our team through diversity.

We know that diverse perspectives—in race, ethnicity, background, age, and gender—are essential to reaching the world for Christ. Together, we're unstoppable.

0.content: Unlike other workplace awards, there is no self-nomination or application process. Instead, it’s entirely based on the feedback our employees have voluntarily and anonymously shared on Glassdoor. To determine the award winners, Glassdoor evaluates company reviews submitted by current and former employees over the past year. This year, we are proud to be recognized as a Best Place to Work among U.S. companies.

00.headingText: One of the best places to work.

00.content: No problem! You can keep learning more about us, our values, and how we care for our team. So go and click around for a bit—we’ll meet you back here! Or, if you’re ready, you can check out our open roles below.

internal.title: How We Hire | Life.Church Careers
internal.seoDescription: Find out what it's like to work at Life.Church and explore all of our open roles

02.headingText: Learn more about how we hire.

00.content:
Life.Church is one church in multiple locations across the U.S. and online. Applying for a position may require relocating to one of our locations across the U.S. or to our Central office in Oklahoma City. 

Oklahoma City offers adventure, community, and a unique place to live out your calling. Take a moment to check out all it has to offer.

0.title: Do I need to be a Christian to work at Life.Church?
0.content: As a religious organization, we make hiring and employment decisions in alignment with our religious beliefs. All Life.Church employees must be Christian, and as such, must consistently seek to live by biblical standards and agree to demonstrate unity within the church with a humble and teachable spirit. We also ask for alignment with our beliefs.

00.content: We hope and expect each staff member is excited about what God is doing through Life.Church. We ask our employees to commit to partner with Life.Church by attending Life.Church consistently, being involved in a LifeGroup, serving in a Life.Church ministry, and tithing.
00.title: Do I need to make Life.Church my church home?

01.title: What's the work culture like at Life.Church?
01.content:
To live out the mission of our church, we actively build our culture through aligning values. Every person on our team knows how powerful it is to serve God alongside people with a passion to build a healthy culture. It's the glue that keeps our team on track over time.

People strive to do their best and strongly emphasize teamwork and achieving your best. Even senior level team members are approachable, and willing to share knowledge and help each other out. That openness is what we think makes Life.Church special.

02.title: How do I stay updated on job opportunities at Life.Church?
02.content: You can always find a list of open positions on our website. Or you can connect with our Talent Community to learn more about open roles and our culture.

03.title: What's the difference between a Central and pastoral role?
03.content:
Life.Church Central Offices support the ministry and operational aspects for all teams and locations including central ministry direction such as IT, HR, etc.

At Life.Church, we’re passionate about reaching more people in more communities. Each LIfe.Church location has a team of pastors who are responsible for their location’s day to day and weekend operations.

When hired for a campus role, new team members begin their journey at an existing Life.Church location to learn the culture and systems of our church from experienced pastors already on the team. Our hope is as we continue to open new locations, we can send pastors who are ready to lead on day one, because of what they’ve learned at an existing location in preparation.

04.title: Do you have internship opportunities?
04.content: Yes! We offer programs tailored to students and recent graduates. Learn more about our Internship Program.

05.title: What if I need work authorization or sponsorship?
05.content: All Life.Church employees need to have current work authorization to work in the U.S. If you don’t currently have authorization to work in the U.S., you’ll need to obtain authorization prior to being hired. Only select roles are eligible for sponsorship and will be determined once a hiring decision has been made. Learn more about work authorization and sponsorship.

06.content:
Most Central Team members are located at our Central Offices in Oklahoma. Our goal is to maintain the culture and collaboration of our church and team, and we believe that's best done in person.

Each Life.Church location has a team of pastors who are responsible for their location’s day to day and weekend operations.
06.title: Where are Central roles located?

07.content: At Life.Church, we believe it’s more than a job—it’s a calling. While you can apply for more than one role, we encourage you to prayerfully apply for the role you feel most aligns with your skills, experience, and interests.
07.title: Can I apply for multiple roles?

08.title: I’ve submitted my application, now what?
08.content:
Once you’ve submitted your application, you’ll receive a confirmation email. Every applicant receives a response via email, regardless of whether they’re offered a position. We receive a lot of applications and personally review each one, so it could take some time to hear back. We do our best to have timely responses at each stage in the process.

It could take an average of four weeks to make it through our interview process.

09.title: What’s the interview process for Central and YouVersion roles?
09.content:
All applications are personally reviewed by our Hiring Leaders. Qualified candidates progress through the interview process: a video introduction, phone interview, panel interview, and pre-employment testing. The final interview can be in person at our Central Offices or via video, and will always involve the candidate and their spouse/fiancé. Certain positions may require additional assessments, which are completed online.

The interview process is one of our best opportunities to get to know your potential and for you to get to know our team and culture. In most cases, you’ll meet with the hiring manager and a variety of other team members. Throughout the process, you’ll have a chance to get to know our team and ask us questions.

It could take an average of four weeks to make it through our interview process.

010.title: What’s the interview process for pastoral roles?
010.content:
All applications are personally reviewed by our Central Ministry Leaders. Qualified candidates are then guided through the interview process: a video introduction, phone interview, panel interview, and pre-employment testing.

We have final interview events for pastoral roles where we bring in all candidates and their spouses/fiancés to our Central Offices for a two-day event (Sunday- Monday). These events are scheduled every 3-4 months, and ministry leaders will communicate the timing of the final interview during the process. Start dates for these roles are usually 3-4 weeks after the interview event.

011.title: What should I wear to an interview?
011.content: We’re a casual work environment. You don’t need to dress up to impress us—jeans are okay!

012.title: What kind of growth opportunities are there at Life.Church?
012.content:
We have a culture of development with opportunities to grow professionally, spiritually, personally, and within your leadership.

While development could lead to leadership advancement, we focus on individual growth. Our prayer is that your family will be closer, your leadership will be sharper, your finances will be stronger, your faith will be deeper, and your heart will be larger.

013.content: Life.Church is pleased to provide our staff with benefits to help them take care of their health, wealth, and well-being now and into the future. Learn more about the benefits we offer.
013.title: What benefits do you offer?

00.content: No problem! You can learn more about us, our values, and how we care for our team. So go and click around for a bit—we’ll meet you back here! Or, if you’re ready, you can check out our open roles below.

internal.title: Internship Opportunities | Life.Church Careers
internal.seoDescription: Find out what it's like to work at Life.Church and explore all of our open roles.

00.content: Life.Church Internships are designed to help young adults grow spiritually, personally, and professionally! It’s all about becoming God’s best version of you, doing what you were created to do, and knowing the next steps to get there.

03.content: Sharpen your skills working alongside full-time pastors doing ministry at our locations and in our communities.
Learn from leaders and innovators in a wide variety of areas like tech, creative, administration, and more.

01.title: How long is the internship?
01.content:
We offer three internship opportunities each year, starting in January, May, and September. Full-time campus and central internships last 6 months.

We also offer a 3-month full-time internship option for the May start date, designed to accommodate college students' schedules. This option allows students to break up their 6-month internship over two summers, interning from May to August.

Part-time internships last 9-12 weeks, typically from June to August and are unpaid.

02.title: Will I be on my own?
02.content: Each intern is matched with a coach. This coach is a Life.Church staff member who is specifically devoted to pouring wisdom into your life and building you up throughout the entire internship. As an intern, you will serve as part of your coach’s staff team. This team will be a major part of your day-to-day development during your internship.

03.title: Are there age limits?
03.content:
Internship applicants are passionate about the “capital C” church and are ready to grow in their walk with Christ, develop personal skills, and gain professional ministry experience. We invite any young adults 18 years or older to apply.

Both full and part-time internships are designed for young adults who are seeking a safe place to grow their confidence and skills in a ministry environment!

04.content: Absolutely! However, you will be responsible for securing your own housing.
04.title: I’m married—am I still eligible?

05.title: Where will I live?
05.content: If you have a housing option near your assigned location (such as a relative or friend), then you are free to secure your own housing. If you need housing, the Life.Church team you are assigned to will assist you in finding housing during your internship, but it’s not guaranteed. Paid interns typically pay no more than $450 a month for housing.

06.title: How many hours per week are expected?
06.content: Campus internships will require 40 hours a week during our full-time internships. Central internships will require a minimum of 25 hours a week and a maximum of 40. Throughout the application and interview process, you’ll need to discuss all scheduling questions or concerns you may have. Your team will do everything possible to work with you to make sure you have a schedule that works best for you.

07.content: Depending on your location, you will work four or five days during the week, and some evenings as needed. The weekends will involve serving at various worship experiences. Your coach will work with you to ensure the best use of your time. Applicants must be flexible with their time and ready for the excitement of an internship and the pace of Life.Church.
07.title: What does a typical week look like?

08.content: No, Life.Church will not provide health insurance to interns. As an intern, you have two options to consider when it comes to health insurance. You can stay on your parent’s health insurance plan (if applicable) or you can purchase your own plan through a private insurance company. You can talk to our Human Resources team and ask them for suggestions on purchasing your own health insurance plan if you are unsure about your options, but no health insurance coverage will be offered to interns through Life.Church.
08.title: Will Life.Church provide health insurance?

09.title: Do I need a personal vehicle?
09.content: Yes. At this time, we cannot provide transportation to and from your assigned location. You are responsible for maintaining adequate insurance on your personal vehicle and having a current driver’s license.

010.title: Will I get a job at Life.Church after my internship?
010.content: Although there’s an opportunity to interview for a staff role at the end of the internship, that isn’t the goal. Our hope is that everyone who completes their internship gains a deeper understanding of who God is, who they are, where they belong, and what their purpose is!

011.content:
Campus internships happen at most physical Life.Church Locations across the United States.

Central internships are located at our Central Offices in Edmond, OK.
011.title: Where will my internship be?

012.title: Are part-time internships available?
012.content:
Yes, un-paid part-time summer internships lasting from June-August are available each year at every Life.Church location.

Apply for a Summer Internship

internal.title: YouVersion | A Digital Ministry of Life.Church
internal.seoDescription: Find out what it's like to work at YouVersion and explore all of our open roles.

00.headingText: “YouVersion isn’t just a company to work for, it’s a ministry that’ll grow you in all facets of your life and use the fruit of your labor to glorify God’s Kingdom.”

08.alt: God’s Word has the power to transform lives and you can help get it to the world.

01.alt: Join our mission, and help us get God’s Word to everyone, everywhere, every day.

00.content: At Life.Church, our mission is to lead people to become fully devoted followers of Christ. And on the YouVersion team, we believe we’re perfectly positioned to do that by helping people seek God through His Word.
When you join our team, you’ll use your gifts to steward our products and help our global Community connect with God in biblically-centered, culturally relevant ways.

02.alt: Shape the future of our Family of Apps.

00.content: YouVersion’s Family of Apps are being used by people on every continent on earth. And when you join our team, you’ll use your gifts to steward our products and help our global Community connect with God in biblically-centered, culturally relevant ways.

God is doing something special here, and we hope this is the place where your skills, talents, and passions meet. We want to equip our team to thrive in every area of life, which is why we provide benefits that matter.
